generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement Learning is a broad field within Deep Learning that encompasses various specialized areas such as Contextual RL and Visual RL. It deals with agents learning to make decisions by performing actions in an environment to maximize some notion of cumulative reward. Contextual RL extends basic reinforcement learning by incorporating context or side information, making it more adaptable to varying situations. Visual RL focuses on environments where the agent receives visual inputs (like images) as part of its observations, which is a common scenario in many real-world applications. Since Reinforcement Learning provides the foundational framework that these specialized domains build upon, it is the most generic and comprehensive choice among the provided options.
